summary: Shows enabling enable mode for all tasks with group_vars (network_cli connection, network OS, ansible_become and ansible_become_method: enable).
questions: How do I enable privileged mode for every task on my switches?

answer_card.title: Enable mode for all tasks via group_vars
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
# group_vars/eos.yml
ansible_connection: ansible.netcommon.network_cli
ansible_network_os: arista.eos.eos
ansible_user: myuser
ansible_become: true
ansible_become_method: enable
```
